7101.name: Grand Peco Feather
7101.description:
A brightly colored feather taken from the wings of a Grand Peco. It can be used to make ornaments and other decorations for women. Or for men, depending on preference... It is very successful for carnival floats.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7102.name: Nightmare
7102.description:
Stone with a macabre smile. They say that if you hold this stone while you sleep, you'll have nightmares about a man with sharp claws. Nobody knows if that's true. But at least it would make a good B-horror movie plot.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7103.name: Unknown Liquid Bottle
7103.description:
AXE Dark Temptation Essence.
AXE Dark Temptation gives you the seductive power of chocolate to help you in the game of conquest.
This essence overflows with sensuality. It makes the wearer irresistible to the opposite sex
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7104.name: False Angel Wing
7104.description:
Fake angel wings. It's possible that merchants will try to sell these little things for the price of normal Angel Wings. You know, hoping to catch some careless buyer. Don't even try it. If a GM catches you doing it, you'll go to jail.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7105.name: False Heaven Ring
7105.description:
A halo used by fake angels. Of course, you can even try to sell one of these as if it were the real thing, but if the GMs catch you, you'll go to jail. Then, goodbye freedom.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7106.name: Antelope Horn
7106.description:
A long, twisted horn, although quite fragile. Getting horned like that isn't even that painful! If a goat comes at you, it's easier to get hurt by the sheer weight of the animal than by its horns...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7107.name: Antelope Skin
7107.description:
Soft goat skin. It's very warm, but it's smelly and full of ticks. Many traders sell carpets made from these skins, claiming they are high-quality wool. It seems that the shopkeepers don't know the difference between a sheep and a goat...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7108.name: Piece of Shield
7108.description:
A piece of a shield as thick and heavy as a wall. It is said to have been the shield of a powerful undead general, capable of bringing the dead back to life. The piece of shield emanates an evil aura... Better get rid of it soon.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7109.name: Shining Spear Blade
7109.description:
The blade of an immense spear, twice the size of a man. The spear is said to drink the souls of impaled victims. People with a strong sense of spiritual awareness become ill at the mere sight of the blade, such is the evil emanating from it.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7110.name: Broken Sword
7110.description:
An old scimitar, worn down by time and battle. It has practically no edge left, and it's all beveled. It's more of a doorstop than a weapon. You'd have better luck using a jar of honey as a weapon...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7111.name: Slick Paper
7111.description:
Soft, sturdy paper. You can draw or write a love letter on it. A word of advice: don't run your finger along the sides. Have you ever cut yourself with paper? Ah, it hurts as much as a Baphomet blow...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7112.name: Sharp Paper
7112.description:
A sheet of paper as sharp as a sword. If it's falling to the ground, don't try to catch it in the air under any circumstances. You could end up without your fingers...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7113.name: Broken Pharaoh Emblem
7113.description:
In ancient times, it was the ultimate symbol of a pharaoh. Now that the pharaohs are dead and buried (from time to time they come back to say "hello"), this stick is used to herd sheep.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7114.name: Masque of Tutankhamen
7114.description:
The golden mask of a pharaoh, representing his divine descent. It's a very beautiful and attractive mask. I mean, "beautiful and attractive" if you like masks buried with dead people... Brrr.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7115.name: Harpy Feather
7115.description:
The feathers of a Harpy. They are used to cover the private parts of female birds. Or rather, "almost all" of their private parts...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7116.name: Harpy Talon
7116.description:
The claws of a Harpy. They say this is where these bird-women store their venom. Just in case, you'd better be careful not to poke yourself with it.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7117.name: Torn Magic Book
7117.description:
A badly damaged old grimoire. It contains forbidden knowledge, but don't even think of trying to use it to capture Bafomé Jrs. The little ones may get angry because they think you're tricking them, and may even call "Daddy" to teach you a lesson...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7118.name: Torn Scroll
7118.description:
A piece of parchment whose magic was consumed during combat. It has no use except as toilet paper. But beware: the risk is all yours. We are not responsible for any accidents.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7119.name: Bacillus
7119.description:
A bacterium in the shape of a bean. It has developed in such a way that it can be seen with the naked eye. It's still moving back and forth. Yes, that's disgusting...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7120.name: Burning Horseshoe
7120.description:
Flaming horseshoes. They are said to belong to the most agile and cruel stallions, the mounts of the unholy army. The horse that used it must have run at incredible speed to have set fire to a horseshoe. I wouldn't want to be his rider...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7121.name: Honey Pot
7121.description:
It was a jar full of honey, nice and sweet. But you were late, the Pasanas ate it all. You knew that Pasanas are fanatics. Now you know that they are also fanatical about honey. Better luck next time!
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7122.name: Burning Hair
7122.description:
Fur that feels like it's on fire. Although it's warm, it's nowhere near on fire. Bald people can wear it as a wig to rock the night away.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7123.name: Dragon Skin
7123.description:
The hard skin of a dragon, located just below its scales. Only very old dragons develop such rigid skins.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7124.name: Sand Clump
7124.description:
A handful of damp sand, forming a little ball of sand. Don't try to imagine where it came from...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7125.name: Scorpion Claw
7125.description:
Long pincers of a scopion. When alive, they were capable of grabbing a sword and breaking it in two. They also seem very resistant.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7126.name: Large Jellopy
7126.description:
What is a Jellopy anyway? Whatever it is, not a few porings have made this one.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7127.name: Alcohol Creation Guide
7127.description:
Instructions for creating alcohol. A handy tool for those wild parties. Ministry of Health warns: this manual may not be sold to anyone under the age of 18.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7128.name: Bottle Grenade Creation Guide
7128.description:
Instruction manual for creating Greek Fire. Avoid showing this book to other people. If they see you holding one of these, they might think you're a terrorist!
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7129.name: Acid Bottle Creation Guide
7129.description:
Instruction manual for creating hydrochloric acid, also known as HCI. When you're making the acid, don't drop it on the book. In fact, don't drop it on ANYTHING that is important to you.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7130.name: Plant Bottle Creation Guide
7130.description:
Instruction manual for growing carnivorous plants and other plants in-vitro. It contains everything from an explanation of how to make a bean sprout on cotton, to how to create a carnivorous plant to attack.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7131.name: Marine Sphere Creation Guide
7131.description:
Instruction manual for the in-vitro creation of Sea Spheres. This allows you to create Sea Bead Pots. Because they are temperamental and have a habit of exploding, keep this book (and the pots) out of the reach of children.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7132.name: Coating Creation Guide
7132.description:
Instruction manual for synthesizing a special wax used to coat and protect user equipment from damage. The wax is extra-fast drying. So keep it out of your maid's reach, so she doesn't waste your precious ingredients cleaning the house...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7133.name: Condensed Potion Creation Guide
7133.description:
Instruction manual with the procedure for creating compact potions. It basically teaches you how to make more potent potions with fewer ingredients. Needless to say, this is a best-selling volume and its author, Marry Stoper, is now a multi-millionaire.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7134.name: Medicine Bowl
7134.description:
A white porcelain bowl, very light and easy to carry. It's also very sturdy and allows the user to grind or mix ingredients to make potions or the like. If you buy it now, you'll also get this wonderful portable pestle that can be taken anywhere and doesn't take up any space!
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7135.name: Bottle Grenade
7135.description:
Light the flask and throw it at a target. The contents of the flask will ignite and columns of fire will rise. Never get confused and pull out the pavil; this is not a grenade. You need the "Greek Fire" skill to use this flask.
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7136.name: Acid Bottle
7136.description:
A very fragile glass containing a concentrated solution of sulphuric acid. If you throw it at an unprotected person, there's a serious chance they'll be hospitalized for several weeks. But of course you don't care about that, right? You need the "Acid Terror" skill to use this bottle.
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7137.name: Plant Bottle
7137.description:
Glass containing several carnivorous plant seeds in suspended animation, cultivated in a fast-growing solution. Break the glass for the seeds to germinate and give rise to a Flora that will attack your enemies. They're also good company to talk to if you're a loner.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7138.name: Marine Sphere Bottle
7138.description:
Light the pavilion and throw the bottle. A Marine Sphere will be born and explode as soon as an enemy approaches. They also work well as party lights. Just don't let anyone get close so that your party doesn't go up in flames - literally. You need the "Create Marine Sphere" skill to use this flask.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7139.name: Glistening Coating
7139.description:
It contains a quick-drying wax that protects the user's equipment. Your armor will also be shiny and beautiful, just like new. The funniest thing is that the liquid itself glows inside the bottle. You need the "Coating" skill to use this flask.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7140.name: Seed of Life
7140.description:
Legend has it that a miraculous seed can be found in the tree of life, Yggdrasil, every two hundred years. Despite its legendary fame, its appearance is that of a chickpea. Very disappointing...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7141.name: Morning Dew of Yggdrasil
7141.description:
The dew that falls from the leaves of the tree of life, Yggdrasil. It is said that a single drop of this can cure any kind of poison or intoxication. There are many ambitious merchants selling vials containing rainwater, claiming to be the legitimate one.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7142.name: Embryo
7142.description:
An embryo contains a humanoid creature with infinite possibilities - it all depends on the creativity of its creator. Meanwhile, it's just a big-headed thing inside an egg.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7143.name: Glass Tube
7143.description:
These capsules hold a liquid containing billions of nanomachines (microscopic machines). This is an ancient technology, discovered in excavations in ancient civilizations. These machines are capable of entering any type of wound and reconstructing the tissue with surgical precision. It is said that even decapitated limbs can be reconstructed. They are also used to grow Homunculus embryos.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7144.name: Potion Creation Guide
7144.description:
Instruction manual with information on how to create conventional potions. Now you can create potions much more cheaply and compete with item shops! It's usually the bedside book of any self-respecting alchemist.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7145.name: Ragnarok T-shirt
7145.description:
T-shirt made of special fabric, light and comfortable. Perfect for playing sports.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7146.name: Vacation Ticket
7146.description:
A ticket to embark on a cruise through the paradise islands of summer. Join us for a summer full of joy!
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7147.name: Jasmine
7147.description:
This exotic flower has an enveloping fragrance. Some people use it to make tea and claim that it has medicinal properties. It may be a small flower, but it can represent something much bigger - like the happiness of the person you love.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7148.name: Mother's Letter
7148.description:
A mother's letter, sent to her son who has been drafted to the front lines on the battlefield. She opened her heart and revealed everything that was inside her, hoping it wouldn't be too late for her son to receive it. Anyone who reads this letter will feel their eyes water.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7149.name: Yellow Plate
7149.description:
An old plate, cracked from constant use. Dishes of this size are used by peasants to drink water or sake.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7150.name: Piece of Bamboo
7150.description:
A piece of bamboo cut close to the buds to be used in a variety of ways. Because it is sturdy, it can be used to store water or food. It can also be used as a container to protect important documents, or as a stick for sword training. They are quite abundant in Amatsu and Kunlun.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7151.name: Oil Paper
7151.description:
A piece of transparent tissue paper. The yellowish color comes from the oil applied several times, ensuring its impermeability. Widely used in the construction of windows and partitions in the eastern kingdoms.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7152.name: Glossy Hair
7152.description:
A handful of brunette hair, well combed, shiny and extremely fragrant. The perfume makes some weak-willed people go into trances and do unimaginable things. But don't try waving these hairs around in front of people, trying to give orders. That kind of thing only works in the movies.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7153.name: Worn-out Kimono
7153.description:
An old obi, a women's garment worn over conventional kimonos. Very colorful and worn by women of high status. The refined designs and high-quality fabric indicate that this obi belonged to a very wealthy woman.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7154.name: Poisonous Powder
7154.description:
Powerful toxin used by Ninja groups for poisoning missions. In small quantities it can cause nausea and, in some cases, even hallucinations. Some people get a kick out of watching the reaction of those affected by it. Don't even think about doing it. We're watching you.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7155.name: Poisonous Toad Skin
7155.description:
The thick, rough skin of a poisonous toad. Popular belief has it that touching this type of skin causes warts to grow on your skin. The Wise say that this is superstition. But have you ever seen a Sage get close to a toad? Yes or no, stay away.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7156.name: Broken Shuriken
7156.description:
Known as the death star, the Shuriken is the ninja's favorite weapon. Fast, silent and deadly. The shape of the star and the insignia inscribed on the metal represent the clan to which the ninja belongs. A ninja could hide hundreds of these stars all over his body. Don't even want to know how...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7157.name: Dark Mask
7157.description:
Black mask that covers the face. Used by groups of oriental spies known as ninja. They are known for being able to infiltrate even the most protected fortresses. Too bad the last wearer of the mask has been drooling, and it's all wet... Jeez.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7158.name: Broken Liquor Jar
7158.description:
Shards from a ceramic jug. The smell of sake is still very strong, but there is no trace of the drink. Alcoholic beverages are prohibited for people under 18. Drink in moderation. And if you do drink, don't ride your Peco Peco or drive your cart!
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7159.name: Tengu Nose
7159.description:
Tengu are minor spirits who personify themselves in the form of crow men. They are drawn to earth by people's vanity. Because they punish vanity, they wear hideous masks with disfigured noses. But don't try to scare anyone with this mask. You risk being laughed at and called Pinocchio.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7160.name: Feudal Lord Permit
7160.description:
A pass issued directly by the Lord of Amatsu. With it, you have access to the castle's dreaded labyrinth. Be warned: many adventurers have never returned from their foray into the endless dungeon...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7161.name: Black Bear Skin
7161.description:
A tuft of bear fur. The funniest thing is that these hairs smell very bad, as if someone had worn them for years and years without taking them off. Avoid putting it near any item you're going to wear later. There's a chance that the stench will impregnate it.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7162.name: Cloud Crumb
7162.description:
A handful of clouds trapped in a jar. Doctors recommend these pots for therapeutic purposes to busy people. Observing this pot for long periods of time can provide the same sensation as observing the open sky.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7163.name: Hard Feeler
7163.description:
Very rigid and sharp antennae. The Prontera Ministry of Health has received reports of Novices suffering cuts, amputations and other serious injuries when trying to use these antennas on their heads. Of course, you never had that idea, right?
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7164.name: Solid Peach
7164.description:
A pink, juicy-looking peach. But it only takes one bite for you to lose all your teeth and start talking like your grandfather. Some people have been accused of committing crimes by using these fruits as weapons against unfaithful husbands, wild animals and corrupt politicians. Here, everything ends in a peach!
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7165.name: Transparent Celestial Robe
7165.description:
A beautiful cloak with transparent, flowing sleeves. It is used to identify the high status of the most talented dancers at the imperial court.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7166.name: Soft Silk
7166.description:
A very fine and soft fabric used to make very high quality garments. It is only made in the West and its manufacture is a state secret. Some people claim crazy things, such as the use of insects to produce the threads. Of course, something so beautiful couldn't be made that way... Could it?
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7167.name: Strange Steel Piece
7167.description:
Two mysterious pieces of cloth held together by interlocking metal teeth. There is a small link that runs up and down the teeth, like a trolley on rails. They say this is a sacred artifact, used to revere dust and wind. It would go well with pants...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7168.name: Giant Butterfly Wing
7168.description:
Large Butterfly Wings. Unfortunately, it doesn't have the same ability as the Butterfly Wing item.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7169.name: Ba Gua
7169.description:
A stone octagon with the eight Chinese trigrams and the symbol of Yin and Yang. It's also called the "Feng Shui compass", the Chinese art of studying the harmony of an environment. Of course, if you don't even believe in horoscopes, let alone this...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7170.name: Tuxedo
7170.description:
The groom's attire at a wedding ceremony. It's quite simple and well cut. Nothing too fancy. But with the money you'll be spending on your wife's dress and the party, it's better to wear something simpler and cheaper. Even if you do look like a penguin.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7171.name: Leopard Skin
7171.description:
Leather taken from a leopard. It's very pretty, with brown polka dots on the orange fur. Many people find it sensual. Some even wear underwear made from this material. If you're one of these people, it's best to seek medical help.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7172.name: Leopard Claw
7172.description:
A baby leopard's sharp claw. It may not look like it, but with a set of these these felines can climb even rocky slopes. Can you imagine what they can do to your skin?
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7174.name: Wrapping Lace
7174.description:
A pretty red ribbon used to decorate presents. After all, a present isn't a present without a red ribbon!
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7175.name: Wrapping Paper
7175.description:
Beautiful, bright green paper with yellow stars. Makes any gift unforgettable.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7176.name: Royal Certificate
7176.description:
A certificate proving your great ability to exterminate monsters. That makes you "THE" guy, even if you are a girl!
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7177.name: Crumb of Sobbing Starlight
7177.description:
A fragment that, they say, was created from starlight. It is possible to join them all together to form a whole jewel.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777770^000000

7178.name: Sobbing Starlight
7178.description:
A very beautiful and shiny jewel. It is said to be created from starlight. If you look closely and concentrate hard enough, you can see words written in an ancient language. If you look too hard, you'll start to see pink elephants... At that point, you'd better stop looking at it.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777770^000000

7179.name: Proof of Donation
7179.description:
A certificate proving the great charity of its bearer. It will count for points when you go to Valhalla or Helheim on the day of Ragnarök! The seal of King Tristam III indicates its authenticity.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7180.name: Hahn Sukbong's Recommendation
7180.description:
This is a ticket from an old event. It no longer seems to be useful.
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7181.name: Receipt
7181.description:
A small paper receipt indicating the items you have bought. Always keep your receipts. You never know when the Prontera tax office might need them.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7182.name: Cacao
7182.description:
A seed from the cocoa tree. These trees do not grow in countries with a cold climate. When ripe, the seeds are roasted, fried and then crushed to form cocoa paste. There are places where this paste is made by trampling on the seeds... Chocolate is solid cocoa paste mixed with milk.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777772^000000

7183.name: Letter from Sister
7183.description:
A letter written by a girl to her older brother. It's not polite to read.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7184.name: Piano Key
7184.description:
A white ivory key. It seems to have been part of a very old piano.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7185.name: Quiz Entry
7185.description:
A voucher needed to take part in the quiz competition.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7186.name: Thin Trunk
7186.description:
Sturdy stems with the same texture as trunks, only softer. Some primates use these vines to move from tree to tree. If you do this, you'll feel the uncontrollable urge to scream at the top of your lungs...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7187.name: Festival Mask
7187.description:
A mask worn during festivals. It's heartbreakingly ugly...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7188.name: Brown Root
7188.description:
A new root, with lots of soil around it.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7189.name: Wooden Heart
7189.description:
An artificial heart created by magic. It is placed in wooden humanoid bodies to bring the golems to life.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7190.name: Solid Husk
7190.description:
An insect shell. It's even tougher than some armor. If you had a lot of these, you could make armor. You'd look like a cockroach. But don't they say cockroaches never die?
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7191.name: Lamp
7191.description:
A red lamp made of tissue paper. It can be found in large quantities in the eastern kingdoms.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7192.name: Vane
7192.description:
A weather vane made of metal. Its blades are very sharp and can cause serious injuries. Assassins use it for their services.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7193.name: Sprout
7193.description:
A seed in which you can see a small vegetable sprouting. If you put it in absorbent cotton, a sprig of vegetables may grow.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7194.name: Soft Blade of Grass
7194.description:
A long, soft leaf. It usually grows in large numbers, forming a green carpet.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7195.name: Slingshot
7195.description:
An antique slingshot. It's a Y-shaped piece of wood with a rubber band. The ammunition is placed in the rubber band. It can be a dangerous weapon in the right hands.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7196.name: Pauldron
7196.description:
A protector for the upper arms. Made of wood, it guarantees some protection. Not that it will save you from a blow from the Baphomet Scythe, but...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7197.name: Tough Vines
7197.description:
An almost dry, almost rigid and almost useful stem. It can be used to make traditional hats.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7198.name: Huge Leaf
7198.description:
A sheet large enough to be used as a parasol or umbrella.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7199.name: Celebration Coin
7199.description:
^FF0000Will be deleted after the event.^000000
^FF0000Account bound.^000000
Coin created to commemorate a random festivity.
Weight: ^7777770^000000

7200.name: Elastic Band
7200.description:
They say that rubber bands were brought by the Wootan gods. It is a material with incredible capabilities. Flexible, it always returns to its normal size if stretched. A thing of the gods.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7201.name: Log
7201.description:
A large piece of wood. It would be perfect for creating a small sculpture or something. But you're far from being an artist. A shame...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7202.name: Pincher of Beetle
7202.description:
A beetle's foot. It's quite big, a stomp from this thing must hurt a lot.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7203.name: Strong Branch
7203.description:
The tip of a tree. It can be used in many different ways as a tool. A real deal-breaker!
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7204.name: Gunpowder
7204.description:
A black, smelly powder that can blow you away. And believe me, it won't be pleasant...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7205.name: Piece of Black Cloth
7205.description:
A piece of black, flowing cloth. The funniest thing is that the cloth seems to disappear in the dark.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7206.name: Black Cat Doll
7206.description:
A cat doll. It's very cute, but it's not exactly the best gift for your loved one. They say it brings bad luck.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7207.name: Old Manteau
7207.description:
An old, worn cover, full of red stains... You don't even want to know what those stains are...
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7208.name: Rusty Kitchen Knife
7208.description:
A butcher's knife. The blade is dull and covered in blood. It makes you shudder to look at it.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7209.name: Helm of Dullahan
7209.description:
A helmet used by the Dark Crusader, the Dullahan. Its interior seems to have been empty for centuries.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7210.name: Armor Piece of Dullahan
7210.description:
A fragment of Dark Templar armor, Dullahan.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7211.name: Fragment of Rossata Stone
7211.description:
The shard of a tablet with several inscriptions in an ancient language. Maybe this was the "Diary of Morroc" at the time of the Pharaohs.
-------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000

7212.name: Hung Doll
7212.description:

7530.name: Travel Brochure (Amatsu)
7530.description:
[Amatsu, the Eastern Paradise]
Amatsu is the first of the countries on Rune-Midgard's eastern island route. You'll notice that its inhabitants are reserved, but once you get to know them, you'll see that they are a welcoming people who value tranquillity and honor above all else.
On your visit, we recommend that you visit the wonderful ^FF0000Temple of the Waters^000000, known for being the home of the spirits that have preserved this land. You can also visit the Imperial Palace and see the best of Amatsu's arcHitecture. Be sure to pay your respects to the ^FF0000Emperor of Amatsu^000000 who, despite being the most liberal of all eastern rulers, values the honor of foreigners.
Also stop by the legendary ^FF0000Hundred-Year Cherry Tree^000000 to see the most beautiful plant in all of Rune-Midgard. It blooms all year round, and the locals venture to say that it is sacred. Many a marriage proposal has been made here. Who knows, maybe you'll have the same luck?
Don't forget to stop by the ^FF0000Carp Pond^000000, located in the middle of the nobility-themed gardens. These ornamental fish are colored in a strong red, white and black, the symbol colors of Amatsu.
[Don't forget to take photos of all these places and show them to your Tour Guide.]

7531.name: Travel Brochure (Kunlun)
7531.description:
[Kunlun, the eastern paradise of clouds]
Juno is known as the City of Clouds, a true marvel of Schwartzwald technology. But there is another cloud city in Rune-Midgard. And this place is Kunlun, the Eastern Cloud Paradise.
The city is also known as the City of Philosophers. Being so high in the sky, its inhabitants have a spectacular view of the entire eastern world. Such a view has given its inhabitants an expansive spirit, which has allowed them to make incredible advances in the archipelago. Kunlun's greatest thinker is depicted in the ^ff0000Great Statue of the Philosopher^000000, located in the center of the city to inspire everyone.
When you visit the city, you can also see the fantastic panorama from the ^ff0000Mirante^000000. But don't think that this is the only attraction. Visit the ^ff0000Meditation Hill^000000, a favorite meditation spot for people all over the world. You can sit there and get incredible ideas that can change your life.
Another must-see is the ^ff0000Miniature City^000000, located to the south of Kunlun. It is said that this city was once inhabited by tiny human beings who worshipped the inhabitants of Cloud City as gods. These little people disappeared a long time ago and remain a mystery to this day.
[Don't forget to take photos of all these places and show them to your Tour Guide.]

7532.name: Travel Brochure (Louyang)
7532.description:
[Louyang, the ancestral fortress]
Spiritism. This is the strongest feature of Louyang. This ancient city dates back even before the creation of Glastheim, but constant wars have reduced it to ruins, a mere shadow of its former self. Still, here the warrior spirit and purity are highly valued.
There are dozens of fascinating sites in Louyang. The ^ff0000Statue of the Tiger and the Warrior^000000 is one of them, and is known for inspiring warriors to do their best in battle. The ^ff0000Hospital^000000 is also very famous, as this is where Rune-Midgard's best-known healers come from. There you'll learn that it's not enough to patch up wounds or use potions. To truly heal, you need to purify your spirit and close the wounds in your heart.
The ^ff0000Golden Palace^000000 is another place of interest, completely surrounded by the Great Wall of Louyang. Just outside the city, you can also visit the ^ff0000Tower of Screams^000000, a place where martial artists train their screams to release their inner strength.
[Don't forget to take photos of all these places and show them to your Tour Guide.]

7533.name: Travel Brochure (Ayothaya)
7533.description:
[Ayothaya, the floating wonder]
Is the suffocating day-to-day life of the metropolis killing you with stress? Then Ayothaya is the place to visit. The city is considered a true spiritual retreat, where those seeking ultimate peace of mind can achieve this goal.
This is an extremely picturesque place, built entirely on floating platforms in calm waters. The gentle movement will make you feel relaxed. But be warned: before you go there, contact your doctor and get some anti-sickness medication. It is highly inadvisable to vomit in the water, in the fountains and especially in the ^ff0000Serene Statue^000000 and ^ff0000Sacred Statue of the Reclining Philosopher^000000.
You can spend hours meditating on the platforms, and the calm swaying will take your body and mind on a journey. When you're free of stress, visit the ^ff0000Temple of Ayothaya^000000 to find the answers to the questions that plague you. After all that meditation, there's nothing better than stuffing your belly! Visit the ^ff0000Tom Yum Goong Restaurant^000000, famous for its aphrodisiac soups! Don't leave Ayothaya without tasting them!
[Don't forget to take photos of all these places and show them to your Tour Guide.]

7623.name: Name Change Coupon
7623.description:
Name Change Coupon.
This coupon must be purchased by the character undergoing the name change.
Procedure:
1) Open the box with the character undergoing the name change.
2) Create an Apprentice with the desired name on the same server as the character.
3) Send an e-mail to with the following information: Login, name of the character that will have the nickname changed, class and level of the character, server, name of the Apprentice created and contact telephone number in the format DDD + number. If the Apprentice is on another account, please also provide the game account on which they were created, their Level Up! account and their personal details, such as full name and e-mail address. If the information does not match, the name will not be changed.
4) Wait for the GM team to analyze it. The change is made within 7 working days.
* Attention: Clan leaders and users punished for benefiting or using BOT will not be able to go through the procedure. In these cases, the change will not be made and the amount spent on the item will not be refunded.

Weight: ^7777770^000000

25076.description:

Weight: ^7777770^000000

25079.name: Last Breath

Weight: ^7777770^000000

25080.name: Fox Marble

Weight: ^7777770^000000

25086.name: Gift-Wrapping Ribbon
25086.description:

That’s why it’s said to only be tied around sufficiently heavy presents.
Weight: ^7777770^000000

25087.name: Old Doll

Weight: ^7777770^000000

Weight: ^7777770^000000

1002727.name: Enchantment Transfer
1002727.description:
A coupon that allows you to transfer an enchantment from a Costume Equipment to another Costume Equipment.
--------------------------
<NAVI>[Transfericat]<INFO>mal_in01,60,112,0,100,0,0</INFO></NAVI>
--------------------------
[^FF0000Notes^000000]
1. This item allows transferring an enchantment from a Costume equipment to another Costume equipment within the same slot.
That means that an enchantment on a 'Upper and Mid' Costume cannot be transferred to a 'Middle' Costume—only to another 'Upper and Mid' Costume.
2. Transfers all enchantments, including Dual, Graphic, and Footprint effects.
3. You must have the target Costume equipped to perform the transfer.
4. You can cancel the transfer by speaking to the NPC.
5. Certain Costumes may not be eligible for transfer.
--------------------------
Weight: ^7777771^000000
